reasoning: As of March 2026, Starmer faces severe unpopularity (-50 approval) and Labour polls around 20%. However, several factors protect him: Labour has a massive 174-seat majority from 2024, making parliamentary rebellion difficult; no general election is required until 2029; Labour leadership challenges require significant MP support and member votes; the May 2026 local elections haven't occurred yet to trigger any crisis. While speculation exists about Burnham and Streeting, no formal challenge has materialized. Historical precedent shows UK PMs rarely resign mid-term without catastrophic events. The remaining ~10 months of 2026 is relatively short for a leadership change to complete.
